sections.title: Trump: Iran war 'effectively over'
sections.body: After meeting Qatar's prime minister, Trump called further US strikes 'quite unlikely'. Rubio reported no progress, and Iran told Washington to accept its seven conditions.

sections.title: Blockade enforced at sea and on land
sections.body: US aircraft disabled the cargo ship Huda running the blockade off Khor Fakkan, with no deaths. CENTCOM set up Task Force Iron Gate to stop goods reaching Iran overland.

sections.title: Abu Dhabi talks open
sections.body: Russia and Ukraine sat down with US envoys on 10 November, the first talks in nine months. US officials float a Russia-Europe security framework and possible sanctions relief.

sections.title: Europe outside the room
sections.body: European officials met Ukraine and the US in Abu Dhabi outside the core format. The Kremlin rejects any European role; France says no security talks before a ceasefire.

sections.title: Iran's reach into Europe
sections.body: France blamed the Revolutionary Guard for cyberattacks on supermarket fridges. The US moved tankers from RAF Mildenhall over an Iranian threat.

sections.title: Houthis hit Riyadh and a pipeline
sections.body: A Houthi attack damaged an Aramco tower in Riyadh on 8 November and a pipeline in the Medina region caught fire on 9 November. Saudi Arabia reported no casualties.

key_developments: US-mediated Russia-Ukraine talks open in Abu Dhabi, the first in nine months.
Trump says further US strikes on Iran are 'quite unlikely'; Rubio reports no progress.
France attributes supermarket cyber sabotage to Iran's Revolutionary Guard and seeks warrants.
IAEA: a drone killed a worker at the Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant after a 10-hour power loss.
China rolls its trade truce over to 10 January, defusing the 10 November deadline.
Herzog gives Eisenkot the mandate to form Israel's government; Netanyahu stays caretaker.
since_last_visit_brief: Russia and Ukraine opened their first US-mediated talks in nine months, and Trump said further US strikes on Iran are unlikely.
